guards.canonical_statement: For the AP Exam, names of replication steps and particular enzymes beyond DNA polymerase, ligase, RNA polymerase, helicase, and topoisomerase are outside required scope.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent over-teaching, or constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_statement: Details and names of enzymes and factors involved in translation steps are outside AP Exam scope.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent over-teaching, or constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_statement: Memorization of the genetic code is outside AP Exam scope except for the start codon AUG; students should use a supplied code chart.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent over-teaching, or constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_statement: Specific named mutations and their detailed effects are beyond AP Exam scope unless provided in a question context.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent over-teaching, or constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_statement: Specific disorders caused by chromosome-number changes are beyond AP Exam scope unless supplied in context.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent over-teaching, or constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_statement: Detailed procedural knowledge of gel electrophoresis, PCR, bacterial transformation, and DNA sequencing is beyond AP Exam scope beyond the required functional principles.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent over-teaching, or constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_statement: Do not answer a generic “bond holding nucleotides together” prompt with hydrogen bonds. Phosphodiester bonds link adjacent nucleotides within a strand; hydrogen bonds stabilize complementary base pairing between strands/regions.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent over-teaching, or constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Typical DNA/RNA structure is not absolute
guards.canonical_statement: Treat double-stranded DNA and single-stranded RNA as typical cellular patterns, not universal rules across all nucleic acids and viruses.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent over-teaching, or constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Extra replication enzyme names are enrichment
guards.canonical_statement: SSBPs, primase, DNA polymerase I/III, and detailed primer-removal machinery are scientifically useful teacher enrichment but are not current AP-required enzyme-name targets.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent over-teaching, or constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_statement: Telomeres/telomerase are valid biology but are outside the current Unit 6 AP-required replication content.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent over-teaching, or constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Transcription location depends on cell type
guards.canonical_statement: Do not encode “transcription occurs in the nucleus” as universal; that statement applies to eukaryotic nuclear genes, while prokaryotes transcribe DNA without a nucleus.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent over-teaching, or constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: TATA box is not every eukaryotic promoter
guards.canonical_statement: Do not equate “eukaryotic promoter” with “TATA box.” TATA is one promoter element found in some genes.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent over-teaching, or constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Exon does not mean entirely protein-coding
guards.canonical_statement: Do not define exons simply as amino-acid-coding sequence; mature transcripts can retain noncoding exon regions such as UTRs.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent over-teaching, or constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_statement: Use near universality, not absolute universality, when connecting the genetic code to common ancestry.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent over-teaching, or constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Ribosome size values are enrichment and corrected
guards.canonical_statement: Do not use the slide’s 30S/40S prokaryotic pair. If ribosomal S values are retained as enrichment, use bacterial 30S + 50S and eukaryotic cytosolic 40S + 60S.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent over-teaching, or constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Retroviral DNA integrates into host DNA
guards.canonical_statement: Do not encode the slide phrase that reverse-transcribed DNA becomes part of RNA. It can integrate into host genomic DNA.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent over-teaching, or constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: trp repressor is not an enzyme
guards.canonical_statement: Do not encode the trp repressor as an allosteric enzyme. It is a regulatory protein activated by the corepressor tryptophan.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent over-teaching, or constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: lac operon is not a human lactase pathway
guards.canonical_statement: Do not teach the lac operon as simply producing lactase. Its structural genes encode bacterial proteins including β-galactosidase and lactose permease.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent over-teaching, or constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_statement: Avoid universal claims that methylation always condenses DNA or that twin disease discordance is simply “inherited epigenetics.” Preserve reversible gene-regulatory effects with appropriate context.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent over-teaching, or constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_statement: Morphogenesis, cytoplasmic determinants, homeotic genes, and apoptosis are teacher enrichment; the current AP-required core is regulation, transcription-factor effects, differential expression, and specialization.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent over-teaching, or constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Frameshift effects are not universally catastrophic
guards.canonical_statement: Insertion/deletion frameshifts can strongly alter downstream coding sequence, but effects vary and in-frame indels do not shift the frame.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent over-teaching, or constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_statement: Named disorders such as trisomy 21 remain contextual enrichment because the current CED excludes specific chromosome-number disorders as required knowledge.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent over-teaching, or constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_statement: Use aneuploidy for gain/loss of individual chromosomes and polyploidy/triploidy for extra whole chromosome sets; do not merge these categories.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent over-teaching, or constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Selection acts on heritable phenotypic variation
guards.canonical_statement: Do not imply every mutation is directly selected. Selection changes frequencies of heritable variants when their phenotypic effects influence reproductive success in context.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent over-teaching, or constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_statement: Teach what gel electrophoresis, PCR, bacterial transformation, and sequencing accomplish and how to interpret results; do not require unnecessary procedural details beyond current CED scope.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent over-teaching, or constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.
